description: Pass a journey stage by named attestation (write — editor+). The ONLY way a stage passes — nothing advances on computed evidence — and who attested is recorded. A conditional pass needs target_date.

conditional.description: Pass with named items still outstanding (default false). Requires target_date.

note.description: What was checked, and by whom, in the attester's own words

stage_id.description: Journey stage UUID — obtain from scf_get_journey

target_date.description: When outstanding items are due (YYYY-MM-DD) — required when conditional is true

name: scf_attest_journey_stage
